title: ThreadBench: Benchmarking Realism in Agentic Simulation of Real-world Discussions
abstract: arXiv:2606.14715v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to simulate real-world interactions, but it remains unclear whether simulated behaviors preserve the content patterns and interaction dynamics of real human behaviors. Existing evaluations often focus on individual comments or task performance, rather than whether simulated behaviors match human behavior at thread level. In this paper, we use Reddit discussions as a concrete testbed for real-world social simulation. Reddit provides public, topic-grounded, multi-party interactions with diverse opinions, experiences, and interaction patterns, making it a useful setting for evaluating whether LLM agents reproduce the distributional and structural properties of real online discussions. We introduce ThreadBench, a benchmark for Reddit discussion simulation built from 9,817 real Reddit threads spanning 8 diverse domains and 116 subdomains. tldr: 提出了ThreadBench——一个基于9,817个真实Reddit帖子、覆盖8大领域和116个子领域的基准，通过统计分析在帖子层面评估LLM智能体模拟真实在线讨论的真实性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ThreadBench, a benchmark built from 9,817 real Reddit threads across 8 domains and 116 subdomains, which uses statistical analyses to evaluate whether LLM agents realistically simulate real-world online discussions at the thread level.
